scope: Combustion native cooldown-reduction helper; static evidence, not production integration
recovered: The named ReduceGameplayEffectDurationRemainingByTime registration belongs to PredGameplayAbility and forwards an active-effect handle and reduction amount to the traced helper.
Invalid or missing active-effect handles return false. For finite duration, remaining time is computed from duration minus elapsed time since the stored start timestamp.

If remaining time exceeds the requested reduction, the full requested reduction is applied. Otherwise the applied reduction is remaining time minus a binary-verified 0.01 seconds. Three stored timestamps are shifted by the resulting amount.
The helper then invokes effect-update, expiry-scheduling and notification paths. The scheduling path recomputes remaining duration from the adjusted timestamp.

The exact Time default binds coefficient 1 to ct_ItemStats/Combustion.PyroCDR. The Blueprint evaluates it at input zero; the recovered row has pre-extrapolation mode 4 and first value 0.5. Previously traced native simple-curve endpoint behavior therefore supports 0.5 seconds without runtime overrides.
limits: The 0.01-second arithmetic remainder is not a certified engine-frame expiry time. Timer tolerance, callbacks, authority and same-frame ordering remain unresolved.
The helper contains an infinite-duration sentinel branch; this review does not generalize its behavior to arbitrary effects or invalid reduction inputs.
Active runtime override selection, eligible damage event delivery and overlapping shared-gate callbacks still need integration evidence; the packaged reduction scalar is resolved without overrides.
No controlled game measurement has validated this behavior. Production retains fixed 15-second Pyro cooldown and explicitly omits Pyromaniac.
